name: Test Tones
author: co-op
description: Plain sine-tone patches generated by co-op's test suite, for checking that an install works. They are not meant to sound good.

patches.notes: Cluster engine metadata over a 0.25 s, 220 Hz sine.
Sampler engine metadata over a 0.25 s, 261.63 Hz sine in a little-endian (sowt) AIFC file.
Drum kit metadata over a 0.5 s, 110 Hz sine.
